NoteTemplateContext.description:
The `zt` root for the `note` template: {@link TemplateItemData} plus the
runtime-computed fields assembled at the app layer (backlinks, resolved
attachment links, flattened annotations, author conveniences).

Flat annotation list across all (or scoped) attachments. Entries carry
every annotation property except `citation`, which only a single-annotation
render resolves.

members.description: All attachments for the item.

members.name: relatedItems
members.description:
Items from Zotero's "Related" panel (`dc:relation`), sorted by title.
Same-library, forward-only, depth-1.

members.description: Full vault-relative literature note path, including `.md`. `null` when unresolvable.

members.name: imgLink
members.description:
Markdown link to the excerpt image, or `null` for annotation types with no
cached excerpt image (everything but `image` and `ink`), which resolves
empty. Call it to render and pipe it through the `embed` filter (or prefix
`!` yourself) for an Obsidian embed. With image import
disabled it links the cached image's `file://` URI; with import enabled it
links the in-vault copy, formatted per the vault's wikilink preference. Pass
`alias` to override the display text (defaults to the image filename). See

the `#`-fragment. See {@link FallibleTemplateLink}. Computed at the app layer.

TemplateParentItemData.description:
Parent literature item as seen from the standalone `annotation` template. The
annot-view drag-insert resolves the item's tags but omits collection rows
entirely — `collections` lives only on {@link TemplateItemData}. Read them
through the full `note` template (`zt.collections`).

members.name: notePath
members.description:
Always `null` on a standalone annotation render (annotation-view
drag/insert, note import) — resolving the parent's real literature-note
path would require app-layer vault-index I/O, which the annotation path
(synchronous on `dragstart`) intentionally avoids. Stubbed rather than
omitted so `zt.parentItem.notePath` reads as "unresolved" instead of
`undefined`.

TemplateTag.description:
A Tag in the template vocabulary. Coerces to `name` in string contexts (like a
collection coerces to its name), so `{{ zt.tags | join: ", " }}` renders tag

ItemExtra.description:
Best-effort structured view of Zotero's `extra` field. Plain data so it is
directly indexable in Liquid, Eta, and JS.

`toString` is non-enumerable, so a spread, `JSON.stringify`, or
`Object.keys` sees the three data properties alone.

members.name: raw
members.description: Original field text verbatim, for a full round-trip.

members.name: fields
members.description:
First value per key — the common-case lookup, e.g.
`zt.extra.fields["tex.mendeley-tags"]`. First-wins: a repeated key keeps
its first occurrence.

members.name: lines
members.description:
Every source row in order, the source of truth {@link ItemExtra.fields}
derives from. Scan it to recover every value of a repeated key.

ExtraLine.description:
One source row of an Extra field, in document order: a parsed pair (`key`
plus trimmed `value`) or a non-pair text/blank row (`key: null`). `raw` is the
verbatim line so interleaved prose is never dropped.

A line splits on its first `:` or `=`, and is a pair only when the key starts
with an ASCII letter and otherwise holds ASCII letters, digits, spaces, dots,
hyphens, or underscores. A line that does not match, and one whose value is
empty, becomes a text row.

A non-enumerable `toString` returns `raw`, same mechanism as {@link ItemExtra}.

members.name: raw
members.description: Verbatim source line.

members.name: key
members.description: Parsed key, trimmed.

members.name: value
members.description: Parsed value, trimmed; always non-empty on a pair row.

members.name: raw
members.description: Verbatim source line.

members.name: key
members.description: Always `null` — prose, blank, and empty-value rows carry no key.

TemplateCollection.description:
A Zotero collection an item belongs to, in the template vocabulary. Coerces
to `name` in string contexts (like a tag coerces to its name).

members.name: key
members.description: Zotero collection key.

members.name: name
members.description: Collection name.

members.name: path
members.description:
Ancestor chain from top-level root to this collection: `path[0]` is the
top-level ancestor, `path[path.length - 1]` is this collection. A plain
array — render with `path.join(" > ")` (or `"/"` for filename folders), or
pipe the collection list through the `collection_paths` filter, which
joins each full ancestor path by a separator (`"/"` by default).

TemplateNoteLink.description:
A child note exposed on {@link NoteTemplateContext.notes} as a link only —
the imported note's Markdown body lives in its own file, never inlined here.
Carries a non-enumerable `toString` rendering its {@link title} (falling back
to {@link key}), so it stringifies to a title in string contexts and previews.

members.name: key
members.description: Bare Zotero key (not scoped).

members.name: indexedKey
members.description: {@link key} for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

members.name: title
members.description: Note title as Zotero stores it; `null` when the row carries none.

members.name: noteLink
members.description:
Renders the Obsidian link; default alias is the live title. Rendering it
queues the child note for import — a link never rendered creates no file,
and an already-imported note links to the existing file without
re-importing.

AnnotationTemplateContext.description:
The `zt` root of the `annotation` template: a {@link TemplateAnnotation} plus
{@link AnnotationTemplateContext.citation}. Entries of `zt.annotations` on the
note root are plain {@link TemplateAnnotation}s — only the single-annotation
render carries a citation.

members.name: citation
members.description:
Page-pinned citation of {@link TemplateAnnotation.parentItem}, rendered
through the `cite` template with this annotation's
{@link TemplateAnnotationBaseData.pageLabel} as locator; `null` when there
is no parent item or it carries no citation key. Computed at the app layer.

cached excerpt image (everything but `image` and `ink`), which resolves
empty. Call it to render and pipe it through the `embed` filter (or prefix
`!` yourself) for an Obsidian embed. With image import
disabled it links the cached image's `file://` URI; with import enabled it
links the in-vault copy, formatted per the vault's wikilink preference. Pass
`alias` to override the display text (defaults to the image filename). See
{@link TemplateLink}. Computed at the app layer.

members.name: comment
members.description: {@link commentHtml} converted to Markdown; `null` when there is no comment. Computed at the app layer.

members.name: fileLink
members.description:
Markdown link to the parent attachment file, deep-linked to this
annotation's {@link page} (`#page=N`); `null` when the file is unresolvable.
Call it to render — pass `alias`/`subpath` to override the display text or
the `#`-fragment. See {@link FallibleTemplateLink}. Computed at the app layer.

members.name: backlink
members.description: Zotero deep link to this annotation. Computed at the app layer.

members.name: parentItem
members.description:
Parent literature item; shared across annotations from the same item.
`null` for an annotation on a standalone attachment (a file with no
parent bibliographic item).

Its `collections` are populated when the annotation renders as part of a
note; see {@link TemplateParentItemData} for the standalone case.

members.name: parentAttachment
members.description: Source attachment; shared across annotations from the same attachment.

members.name: key
members.description: Zotero item key of the annotation.

members.name: indexedKey
members.description: {@link key} for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

members.name: libraryID
members.description: Zotero library ID holding the annotation.

members.name: type
members.description:
Annotation kind: `"highlight"`, `"note"`, `"image"`, `"ink"`,
`"underline"`, or `"text"`; `"unknown"` for a type Zotero added after this
release.

members.name: text
members.description:
The highlighted or underlined excerpt; `null` when the type carries none.
Verbatim as Zotero stores it, so it can hold the attribute-free inline tags
the reader's editor allows (`<i>`, `<b>`, `<sub>`, `<sup>`).

members.name: commentHtml
members.description:
Raw comment HTML as stored by Zotero — "plain text flavored with some HTML
tags" (only `<i>`/`<b>`/`<sub>`/`<sup>` plus `\n` line breaks); `null` when
there is no comment. For rendered Markdown use {@link comment}.

members.name: colorHex
members.description: Hex color, e.g. `"#ffd400"`.

members.name: colorName
members.description:
Zotero palette name — `"yellow"`, `"red"`, `"green"`, `"blue"`,
`"purple"`, `"magenta"`, `"orange"`, `"gray"`, or `"plum"`; `null` when
{@link TemplateAnnotationBaseData.colorHex} is absent or holds a custom
color outside the palette.

members.name: pageLabel
members.description: Page label as the document itself shows it, e.g. `"42"`, `"iv"`.

members.name: page
members.description:
1-based page number derived from the PDF position (`pageIndex + 1`); `null`
for annotations with no page index (EPUB / snapshot). Unlike
{@link pageLabel} this ignores the document's own page labelling.

members.name: authorName
members.description: Annotation author as stored on the annotation row; `null` when the row records none.

members.name: isExternal
members.description: Whether Zotero marks the annotation as external.

members.name: dateAdded
members.description: When the annotation was created. Second precision, like an item's timestamps.

members.name: dateModified
members.description: When the annotation was last modified; same precision as {@link dateAdded}.

members.name: tags
members.description: Tags applied to this annotation.

TemplateFilenameItemData.description:
The `zt` root of the `filename` template: an item's own
{@link TemplateItemBaseData}, its collections, and inert `notePath` /
`noteLink` stubs. The note-body context is absent — no `backlink`,
`weblink`, `annotations`, `attachments`, `relatedItems`, `authors`,
`authorsShort`, or `notes` — so naming a note stays a single-item read.

members.name: notePath
members.description:
Always `""` — the note does not exist yet when a filename is resolved.
Stubbed (rather than omitted) so a filename template that references
{@link TemplateItemData.notePath} does not throw; matches
{@link TemplateItemData.notePath}'s `string | null` contract.

members.name: noteLink
members.description: Always returns `""`; matches {@link TemplateItemData.noteLink}'s signature.

members.name: collections
members.description: Collections the item belongs to, sorted by name; trashed collections excluded.

members.name: key
members.description: Zotero item key, e.g. `"ABC12345"`; unique within its library.

members.name: groupID
members.description: Group library ID; `null` for the personal library.

members.name: libraryID
members.description: Zotero library ID holding the item.

members.name: indexedKey
members.description: {@link key} for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

members.name: itemType
members.description: Zotero item type, e.g. `"journalArticle"`, `"book"`.

members.name: dateAdded
members.description:
When the item was added to Zotero. Second precision — Zotero stores the
timestamp as a UTC string with no sub-second component. Renders as the
local date (e.g. `2026-06-21`) in `{{ }}` output.

members.name: dateModified
members.description:
When the item was last modified in Zotero; same precision and rendering as
{@link TemplateItemBaseData.dateAdded}.

members.name: creators
members.description: Every creator on the item, in Zotero's own order.

members.name: primaryCreatorType
members.description:
The creator role Zotero treats as primary for this item type, e.g.
`"author"` for a journal article, `"director"` for a film; `null` when the
type defines none.

members.name: tags
members.description: Tags applied to the item.

members.name: title
members.description: Item title.

members.name: abstract
members.description:
Abstract text. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's `abstractNote`, which
stays accessible — both `zt.abstract` and `zt.abstractNote` work.

members.name: containerTitle
members.description:
Journal or container title. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's
`publicationTitle`, which stays accessible — both names work.

members.name: citationKey
members.description: Citation key, from Better BibTeX or Zotero's native citation key.

members.name: citekey
members.description: Alias for {@link citationKey}; both stay accessible on `zt.*`.

members.name: date
members.description: Publication date, parsed from Zotero's multipart `date` field.

members.name: shortTitle
members.description: Short title.

members.name: DOI
members.description: Digital Object Identifier.

members.name: url
members.description: Item URL.

members.name: ISBN
members.description: ISBN.

members.name: ISSN
members.description: ISSN.

members.name: volume
members.description: Volume.

members.name: issue
members.description: Issue.

members.name: pages
members.description: Page range.

members.name: publisher
members.description: Publisher.

members.name: place
members.description: Place of publication.

members.name: edition
members.description: Edition.

members.name: language
members.description: Language, verbatim as Zotero stores it, e.g. `"en-US"`, `"English"`.

members.name: extra
members.description:
Parsed best-effort from Zotero's free-text `extra` field; prints `raw`.
`null` when the field is empty or absent.

additional.description:
Item-type-specific Zotero fields beyond the typed ones above, each under
its canonical name — e.g. `zt.conferenceName`, `zt.numPages`. A field
Zotero maps to a base field is reachable through that base name alone:
read `blogTitle` as `zt.publicationTitle`, `studio` as `zt.publisher`,
`reportNumber` as `zt.number`, `thesisType` as `zt.type`.
